WELCOME TO NOWFOCUS
You decide what deserves your attention.
Start a focus session and the sites and apps you pick stop reaching you.
One tap starts a focus session
Blocks the sites and apps you pick
No 5-second off switch, if you choose Strict or Locked
STEP 2 OF 7 · GOALS
What are you focusing for?
We\'ll remind you while you wait to end a Strict session early, and when a blocked app opens. Stays on this phone.
STEP 3 OF 7 · PEOPLE
Who matters to you?
When a blocked app opens, we\'ll point you to someone you haven\'t talked to in a while, with one tap to call or text. Nothing leaves this phone.
STEP 4 OF 7 · HEADS UP
Android will say NowFocus wants full control of your phone. That\'s normal.
Any app that blocks other apps, like every focus and productivity app, needs this permission, and Android shows the same strong warning for all of them. Here is what NowFocus actually does:
We only notice which app is in front, so we can block the ones you chose.
Nothing on screen is stored or sent anywhere. It all stays on this phone.
You can turn it off any time in Settings → Accessibility.
STEP 5 OF 7 · OPEN SOURCE
Don\'t take our word for it. Read the code.

NowFocus is open source. The full code is public, so anyone, including other people and developers, can scrutinize it and check exactly what this permission is used for. You don\'t have to trust us, you can verify.
View the source code
When you tap Allow next: Settings opens, tap NowFocus, switch it on, then press Allow.
STEP 6 OF 7 · PERMISSIONS
A few permissions, so blocking actually holds.
Blocking runs on this phone. Your browsing never leaves it. Your app and site lists sync only if you sign in.
Spots when a blocked app opens. With partial blocking on, also reads the YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, X and TikTok screens during a session (experimental), on-device only
Blocks sites on-device, no traffic routed anywhere
Lets Bedtime Wind-Down quiet things down

Which app steals your time?
Pick one, and we\'ll block it for 10 minutes. You can end it any time.
